title: Qualify seven-package offline Math distribution and current public API surface
commitMessage: docs: qualify offline Math distribution package graph and API surface

contribution.summary: Qualify the current seven-package net10 Math distribution through an isolated offline NuGet-only consumer, without publication. Restore locked sources, build the distribution and six prerequisites, pack seven local archives, verify ZIP identities and dependency edges, and execute the existing eight-probe managed public API consumer in a private package cache.
contribution.value: A read-only BCL C# verifier audits source PackageIds, versions, dependencies, historical source-pinned M5 and RS125 facts, and all 541 completed DWF nodes. Twelve local commands pack seven current libraries, inspect their archive hashes and readme/NOTICE, restore the independent distribution consumer from an offline feed and run eight public-surface, mathematical and refusal checks. The receipt retains seven current ZIP, managed DLL and public API SHA identities. No cross-version ABI, public package, other RID or external migration is inferred.
debtChanges: Seven current net10 libraries and eight fresh consumer probes do not requalify every historical Math consumer or certify public semver compatibility.
Observed per-archive API SHA fingerprints cannot establish cross-version source/binary ABI or support on another RID.
Discovery agent skills, AURA/Decision/MCDM integration, publication rights and public NuGet release remain unapproved.
The accepted M0-M7 backlog and all 541 native DWF nodes remain unchanged; no achievement or new milestone is declared.
contribution.nextAction: On verified RS126 success, consider a separate version-pinned API/ABI comparison or other current source-free consumers. Do not publish packages, send the AURA/Decision/MCDM drafts, introduce providers or fabricate M8.
